output.reason: A 71-year-old woman with severe right hip pain and complete inability to bear weight after a fall this morning has a likely hip/femur fracture requiring immediate emergency imaging and orthopedic care, and she cannot be safely moved or transported without assistance.
output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. A fall with severe hip pain and inability to stand at your age very likely means a broken hip, which needs emergency X-rays and orthopedic treatment today. Stay where you are, keep the leg still, and do not try to walk or have someone lift you. Do not eat or drink while waiting, in case surgery is needed.
differential: Occult hip fracture or pelvic ramus fracture
